definition_english: A security charge created by a borrower over existing or future movable property in favour of a lender, where ownership and possession of the asset stay with the borrower.
definition_hindi: ऋण की प्रतिभूति के रूप में उधारकर्ता द्वारा किसी वर्तमान या भावी चल संपत्ति पर ऋणदाता के पक्ष में सृजित प्रभार, जिसमें संपत्ति का स्वामित्व और कब्ज़ा उधारकर्ता के पास ही रहता है।

linguistic_analysis.sense_structure: Sense 1: commercial and legal security charge. Tax hypothecation is a separate sense, HAT-002-S2.
linguistic_analysis.word_formation: दृष्टिबंधक is a transparent compound; आडमान is a borrowing.
linguistic_analysis.semantic_loss: Hindi needs conjunct verbs for the English verb hypothecate; gender is obligatory in Hindi.
linguistic_analysis.register: दृष्टिबंधक for banking; आडमान for statutes.

conceptual_analysis.core_boundary: A non-possessory security interest over movable property; the borrower keeps ownership and possession.
not_implied: A mere right to retain goods

critical_distinctions.vs_pledge: A pledge transfers possession to the lender; hypothecation does not.
critical_distinctions.vs_mortgage: A mortgage concerns immovable property; hypothecation concerns movable property.
critical_distinctions.vs_lien: A lien is a right to retain goods already in the holder's possession.

pairwise_comparison.difference: Banking register versus statutory register; आडमान is less familiar to general readers.
मालबंधन suggests goods only and is narrower for intangible movables.
Suggests mortgage or pledge, not a non-possessory charge.
